cards.meaning: a merger or fusion of two entities into one — a business/finance-register term for a corporate combination
cards.example: Nagsasanib ang dalawang kumpanya para lumawak ang kanilang serbisyo.
cards.exampleMeaning: The two companies are merging to expand their services.
cards.note: Stronger than 'pagsasama' (any general joining) and distinct from 'pakikipagsosyo' (a partnership where both sides keep separate identities) — 'pagsasanib' implies one entity dissolving fully into the other.
cards.tiesTo: Grab's $1.49 billion acquisition of a 60% stake in fintech Atome Financial

cards.meaning: the formal trial process — the hearing and examination of a case in court
cards.example: Nagsimula na ang paglilitis matapos ang kanyang pagdeklara ng 'hindi guilty.'
cards.exampleMeaning: The trial has already begun following his 'not guilty' plea.
cards.note: Legal/formal register, distinct from 'imbestigasyon' (a preliminary investigation before a case reaches court) — 'paglilitis' marks the official in-court hearing stage where evidence is presented and contested.
cards.tiesTo: Sandiganbayan pre-marking evidence in the plunder trial of former Speaker Martin Romualdez

cards.meaning: "in case; what if" — a connective introducing an unwelcome or worrying hypothetical
cards.example: 万一土地拍卖再次流拍，地方政府的财政压力会更大。
cards.examplePinyin: Wànyī tǔdì pāimài zàicì liúpāi, dìfāng zhèngfǔ de cáizhèng yālì huì gèng dà.
cards.exampleMeaning: In case the land auction fails again, local governments' fiscal pressure will get even worse.
cards.note: Register: flexible (口语/书面语). Contrast with the neutral 如果 ("if") — 万一 carries a worried undertone, used for a real risk being hedged against rather than a plain hypothetical.
cards.tiesTo: Beijing land auction collapsing after only one of three interested developers showed up

cards.meaning: "fiscal gap/shortfall" — a formal, written-register term for a structural shortfall in funding capacity
cards.example: 卖地收入下降，扩大了地方政府的财政缺口。
cards.examplePinyin: Mài dì shōurù xiàjiàng, kuòdàle dìfāng zhèngfǔ de cáizhèng quēkǒu.
cards.exampleMeaning: Falling land-sale revenue has widened local governments' fiscal gap.
cards.note: Register: 书面语 (formal, financial/policy reporting). Contrast with 赤字 ("deficit" — a narrower, everyday word for one year's budget shortfall) — 财政缺口 points to a broader, structural funding shortfall. Collocates with 弥补 ("to make up the gap") and 扩大 ("to widen").
cards.tiesTo: China's H1 2026 land-sale revenue falling 31.5% y/y, straining local government finances
